resources.string: Enter your PIN using at least 3 whole digits 0–9 only — no decimal point, operators, or functions. Then press and hold =.
Enter your operator sequence using only + − × ÷ ^ — at least 3 (repeats are allowed, e.g. × × ÷ ÷). Then press and hold =.
That isn\'t a valid PIN. Use whole digits 0–9 only — no decimal point, operators, or functions — then press and hold =.
Your PIN needs at least 3 digits. Enter 3 or more whole digits (0–9), then press and hold =.
Only operators (+ − × ÷ ^) belong in the sequence. Press and hold = when the sequence is complete.
Your operator sequence needs at least 3 operators. Add more of + − × ÷ ^, then press and hold =.
That didn\'t match your first entry. Enter the same digits and the same operator sequence both times.
Couldn\'t save the PIN on this device. Press and hold = to try again.
No operators entered. Add at least one of + − × ÷ ^ after the digits, then press and hold =.
